dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Diabetic striatopathy (nonketotic hyperglycemia–associated left basal-ganglia chorea/hemiballismus) due to severely uncontrolled diabetes mellitus

Alternative: Primary basal-ganglia intracerebral hemorrhage

Alternative: Basal-ganglia calcification or other structural lesion

Alternative: Wilson disease or another acquired/metabolic chorea syndrome
